lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition MgCr₂ (Mg₈Cr₁₆ per cell) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 24 atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both Cr and Mg centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors; Cr centers coordinate to 8 Cr and 4 Mg neighbors, while Mg centers coordinate to 10 Cr and 2 Mg neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Cr-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Cr- and Mg-centered polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
